points.description: Selects C (the water level went up when the water froze).
Explains that water expands when it freezes (equivalent wording accepted).

rubric.notes: Full marks require both the correct choice (C) and an explanation stating that water expands when it freezes. A correct choice with no explanation, or the correct explanation attached to a wrong choice, earns half marks. No marks for choosing A or B without a valid expansion explanation.
